rows.task: Every theorem assigned P1 formal / P2 finite-exact / P3 bound / P4 empirical / P5 impossibility class.
Every P1 theorem gets machine-checkable proof where practical.
Every P2 claim gets exhaustive certificate/oracle.
Every P3 bound states distributional assumptions.
Every P4 hypothesis maps to a preregistered experiment.
Every P5 limit gets explicit consequence/claim ceiling.
Every theorem has quantifiers and domains stated explicitly.
Every theorem has nearest counterexample when a load-bearing assumption is removed.
Every attractive universal claim is tested against NFL, Rice/halting, Gödel, Blum speedup and finite-state/OEE limits where relevant.

scope: canonical T602 theorem corpus named by GMI_602_CLOSURE_DEPENDENCIES_V1.json
